<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**4** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ✅

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **45** of **222** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **177** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`

Coarse fallback — **7** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bb418686547de42c8feae103fa2e41dd419aa171` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `c659757fa7a64cc111434ead3938872bac59416b` — the merge of head `2654222fd35b4be14723b4ad1e913334ef48d3ed` into base `bb418686547de42c8feae103fa2e41dd419aa171`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin c659757fa7a64cc111434ead3938872bac59416b && git checkout c659757fa7a64cc111434ead3938872bac59416b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin bb418686547de42c8feae103fa2e41dd419aa171 2654222fd35b4be14723b4ad1e913334ef48d3ed && git checkout -B drift-repro bb418686547de42c8feae103fa2e41dd419aa171 && git merge --no-ff 2654222fd35b4be14723b4ad1e913334ef48d3ed

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json bb418686547de42c8feae103fa2e41dd419aa171
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>
